description: Source code for a Zephyr-based LWM2M client application, implementing device management, network event handling, and LWM2M protocol interactions.

methods.name: device_reboot_cb
methods.description: Callback to handle device reboot command, adds low power error and modifies battery voltage.

methods.name: device_factory_default_cb
methods.description: Callback to reset device to factory defaults, adds GPS failure error and modifies USB current.

methods.name: lwm2m_setup
methods.description: Initializes LWM2M objects and resources, including security, device info, firmware, temperature sensor, and LED control.

methods.name: rd_client_event
methods.description: Handles various LWM2M client events such as registration, bootstrap, errors, and disconnections.

methods.name: socket_state
methods.description: Logs socket state changes during LWM2M communication.

methods.name: observe_cb
methods.description: Handles observation events such as observer addition, removal, acknowledgments, and timeouts.

methods.name: on_net_event_l4_disconnected
methods.description: Handles network disconnection event, pauses LWM2M engine.

methods.name: on_net_event_l4_connected
methods.description: Handles network connection event, resumes LWM2M engine.

methods.name: l4_event_handler
methods.description: Handles L4 network events, triggers connection or disconnection handlers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing network, setting up LWM2M client, and starting the client process.
